LOST YOUR TV REMOTE AGAIN? TAKE CONTROL INSTANTLY.

Turn your iPhone or iPad into a powerful universal TV remote in seconds. Change channels, adjust volume, launch Netflix or YouTube, and cast photos or videos directly to your TV. No more searching for remotes. No more dead batteries. Just tap and control.

TRUSTED BY MILLIONS
• 10M+ downloads
• Top 50 in Utilities
• 4.8 rating with 50K+ reviews

---------------------------------

TAKE CONTROL IN UNDER A MINUTE
Connect your phone and TV to the same Wi-Fi. The app automatically detects your device. No pairing codes. No complicated setup. Start controlling your TV almost instantly.

ONE APP. TOTAL CONTROL.
• Change channels instantly
• Adjust volume smoothly
• Launch streaming apps with one tap
• Power on or off supported TVs
• Navigate menus faster than a traditional remote

Stop switching between remotes. Everything you need is in one place.

SEARCH FASTER. WATCH MORE.
Typing with a TV remote is frustrating. Use your phone’s keyboard or voice search to find movies and shows in seconds. Spend less time searching and more time watching.

CAST AND SHARE ON THE BIG SCREEN
Show photos from your gallery. Play videos directly from your phone. Stream music for parties or family nights.

Turn any moment into a big-screen experience.

COMPATIBLE WITH MOST SMART TV BRANDS
- Roku
- TCL
- Sony
- LG Smart TV
- Samsung
- Android TV
- Hisense
- Fire TV
- Philips
- Vizio

Join millions of users who replaced their physical remote.

PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION
Upgrade to Premium to remove ads and unlock all features. Subscription is $6.99 per week.

Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Subscriptions can be managed in Account Settings after purchase.

Universal Remote TV Control・ is not affiliated with or endorsed by any TV brands mentioned.
